verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch has team/workspace collaboration (gh-6) and admin dashboards with 'enhanced user management' and server configuration (docs-6, docs-28), plus enterprise SSO/audit logs (docs-12, docs-30), implying some access-control layer, but no evidence explicitly describes role-based permissions for viewing/editing specific APIs or collections. Missing for 10: documented role definitions (admin/editor/viewer), collection-level permission scoping, and independent confirmation that granular RBAC works as described.
